item.title: pydantic 2.14.3 (pypi) — breaking/deprecated wording
item.description: Quote: …yO3 version bump. A CI workflow issue made it so that the wheel wasn't tested before publishing. This is now fixed: starting in v2.14.3, we no longer publish GraalPy 3.11 wheels, and GraalPy 3.13 wheels are now published together with the existing 3.12 one.… Release notes: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/releases/tag/v2.14.3
